input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Sylva, Dillsboro, Cullowhee, Cashiers, Cherokee and Bryson City, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: overnight summer camp Cashiers Cullowhee Sylva 2026
Nantahala Outdoor Center youth overnight camp 2026

candidates.name: YMCA of Western North Carolina
candidates.note: Camp Watia offers sleepaway camp and teen leadership programs for ages 8–17; summer 2027 registration is open.

candidates.name: Camp Living Water
candidates.note: Christian summer youth camps for ages 7–12 and 13–17, with tubing, hiking and rafting.

candidates.name: Bravo: Blue Ridge Adventures
candidates.note: July 12–16, 2026 Nantahala overnight adventure camp for youth who are blind or have significant visual impairments.

candidates.name: Western Carolina University
candidates.note: Summer Symposium offers a five-day marching-arts camp; Summer Ventures provides supervised residential science and mathematics study.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: Adventure-based sleepaway programs for youth with ADHD and learning differences, based at Balsam.

candidates.name: Camp Merrie-Woode
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight summer camp near Cashiers, with outdoor adventure and arts; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: Skyland Camp and Retreats
candidates.note: Girls’ sleepaway camp for rising grades 1–10, plus mother-daughter sessions; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Daniel Boone Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Daniel Boone runs Scout resident camp, high-adventure programs and living-history camp; 2027 registration available.

candidates.name: Lake Logan
candidates.note: Camp Henry offers traditional overnight sessions, outdoor school and teen leadership programs; summer 2026 programs documented.

candidates.name: M28 Ministries
candidates.note: Four-day residential summer programs for middle and high school youth, combining worship, discipleship and recreation.
